# Krishnendu Biswas

> Official personal chronicle, technical portfolio, and AI research profile of Krishnendu Biswas.

Krishnendu Biswas is an AI systems developer, machine learning researcher, and management scholar at the Indian Institute of Management Ranchi (MBA 2025-27, BBA 2025) and the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (Programming Diploma 2026). He specializes in multi-agent orchestration, natural language processing, parameter-efficient transformer fine-tuning, and imbalanced dataset modeling.

## Identity & Canonical Links
- Canonical Website: https://krishnendu.me/
- GitHub: https://github.com/krshnndu
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/krshnndu
- Institutional Email: krishnendu.biswasi22@iimranchi.ac.in
- Aliases: Krishnendu, Krshnndu, Krishnendu Biswas (IIM Ranchi)

## Academic Affiliations & Education
- Indian Institute of Management Ranchi (IIM Ranchi): Master of Business Administration (MBA, 2025-2027), Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA, 2022-2025). Senior Executive Member, Corporate Relations & Placement Committee.
- Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras): Diploma in Programming (2026).

## Core Specializations in AI & Machine Learning
- AI Systems & Multi-Agent Architectures: Designs and deploys autonomous multi-agent harnesses, persistent memory pipelines, and tool execution engines.
- Natural Language Processing (NLP): Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA on DeBERTa-v3 and RoBERTa), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with vector databases, and semantic text classification.
- Machine Learning & Data Science: Imbalanced dialogue classification (SVMSMOTE), gradient boosted decision trees (LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost), and Bayesian optimization (Optuna).

## Peer-Reviewed Publications & Scholarly Research
- "Multi-Class Affect Detection in Educational Chatbots: Evidence from Imbalanced Dialogue Data" (Springer Nature, FICTA 2026). Authored research presenting a RoBERTa and SVMSMOTE framework for imbalanced dialogue emotion recognition, achieving 74.19% recall on confused-emotion class.
- "Adoption and Implications of Generative AI in Marketing: A Systematic Review and Research Agenda" (10th Pan-IIM WMC 2025, IIM Ranchi). Authored PRISMA systematic literature review synthesizing 29 Scopus-indexed studies from 2020 to 2025.

## Key Technical Projects
- Smart MCQ Ranking System: Fine-tuned microsoft/deberta-v3-base and roberta-base via LoRA for 5-option multiple-choice evaluation, scoring 0.74242 MAP@3 on unseen test data.
- 4-Class Comment Classification: Processed 198,000 comments using 10,000+ n-gram features and behavioral metrics, achieving 0.8293 F1-Macro via LightGBM and Nelder-Mead optimization.
- Customer Churn & Exit Prediction Engine: Benchmark suite over 90,000 banking records using Random Forest and LightGBM, reaching 0.6365 validation F1 on rare exit classes.
- Virtual AI Teaching Assistant: Context-grounded RAG assistant powered by vector embeddings and SQLite store with FastAPI endpoints.

## Professional Experience
- QualityKiosk Technologies (Navi Mumbai): Data & AI Intern (2025). Developed automated synthetic test-data generation pipelines and API automation harnesses.
- Tata Steel (Jamshedpur): Research Analyst Intern (2024). Conducted corporate social impact modeling and demographic analytics across 10 villages.
